latHint: Think what we do after we feel a loss.
pivHint: Jeremiah says the one who trusts in the Lord is BLESSed. In the Beatitudes, the second blessing Jesus gives is to those who ______.
winText: You found it. BLESS isn't just what Jeremiah says of the one who trusts in the Lord. In the Beatitudes, Jesus BLESSes those who MOURN.
lossText: The word was MOURN. BLESS was the pivot. In the Beatitudes, Jesus declares that those who MOURN are BLESSed, and promises that they will be comforted.
votdVerse: But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him.
passageText: “But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him. They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit.”
